app.title: NetConfigLint
mode.snippet.detail: Paste part of a configuration to check it. Omitted settings are not treated as confirmed missing.
mode.message.detail: Interpret logs, prompts and errors with possible investigation steps.
mode.view.detail: Infer basic state and structure from visible routes, interfaces and neighbors.
mode.full.detail: Combine available full configuration, operational output and supported log interpretation.
mode.snapshot.detail: Paste the complete configuration plus route or peer command output to include supported runtime evidence.
page.about.tagline: A fast, offline, extensible static analyzer for network device configurations.
analysis.filter_empty_detail: Select the active severity again to show all diagnostics.
history.empty_detail: Completed analyses will appear here when history is enabled.
history.disable_confirm: Turning off history deletes all saved configurations and analysis results. Continue?
about.license: NetConfigLint is open source under the Apache License 2.0. Configuration analysis runs locally.
about.disclaimer: Static analysis cannot guarantee operation on physical hardware. Validate production changes using vendor-supported procedures and an appropriate lab or staging environment.
panels.reorder: Drag to reorder; arrow keys to move
analysis.failed: Analysis failed. Check the input and try again.
analysis.unsupported: Unable to identify a supported vendor. Select a vendor or check the configuration.
analysis.changed: Configuration or analysis options changed. Run analysis again.
export.diagnostics_first: Diagnostics first, then code with severity counts
export.needs_analysis: Analyze the current configuration first, or export configuration only.
export.error: Could not save the export. Check the destination and permissions.
file.open_error: Could not open the file. Use a readable UTF-8 or GB18030 configuration file.
file.encoding_recovered: Some undecodable bytes are shown as visible markers; verify those positions.
file.bundle_preview: Showing the running configuration and issue evidence; exports still use the complete diagnostic bundle.
history.recovery_warning: Some history could not be read. The original file is preserved; recover it or clear history before saving.
analysis.coverage_scope: Only supported rules are checked. Recognition does not mean full validation. Up to 80 line numbers are shown; exports contain the full list.
